# Options Checklist: Product Options (Task 5)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review gate for the product options spec before planning
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: specs/009-product-options/spec.md

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are variant requirements specified for own-price semantics (replace vs adjust) across all example kinds? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are group requirements specified for optional/required status plus min-max pick counts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are choice requirements specified for naming and minor-unit adjustments including zero? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are quantity-extra requirements specified with bounded simple rules? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are selection-display requirements specified for cart, confirmation, tracking, dashboards, and exports? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are snapshot requirements specified for names, prices, and immunity to definition edits? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "replaces the base price" defined with an exact computation rule for variant plus add-ons? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are "bounded, simple rules" for extras quantified with explicit limits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "clearly show selected options" defined with required content per surface (cart, order, tracking)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "additive extension pattern" for future capabilities defined enough to prevent restructuring? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "configurator complexity" bounded with explicit excluded mechanics? [Clarity, Spec §Constraints]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 - Are pricing requirements consistent between variant-replace and choice-adjust semantics? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are required-group requirements consistent between blocking behavior and min-max counts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are option-free preservation requirements consistent across view, cart, checkout, tracking, and history? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are currency requirements for option prices consistent with the per-business money model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 - Can SC-003 per-kind correctness be verified with exact expected totals? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK017 - Can SC-004 tamper neutralization be tested for each listed tamper class? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK018 - Can SC-005 snapshot completeness be verified after definition edits and deletions? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are SC-002 preservation checks enumerated for option-free products and historical orders? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are SC-001 time bounds scoped with defined start and end points? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are primary-flow requirements defined for configure-to-tracking on each example kind? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are alternate-flow requirements defined for stripped-to-simple products and edited definitions? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are exception-flow requirements defined for unchosen required groups and invalid quantities? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are recovery requirements defined for concurrent definition edits during checkout? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for deleted groups/choices referenced by stored snapshots? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are requirements defined for wrong-business option submissions? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are requirements defined for unavailable choices mid-configuration? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK028 - Are tenant-isolation requirements specified for definitions, selections, and snapshots? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are validation and authorization requirements specified at every trust boundary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are guest-checkout requirements preserved explicitly for option flows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are simplicity requirements specified as customer-step limits rather than aspirations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK032 - Is the storage-shape deferral to plan documented with the guaranteed properties it must satisfy? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are out-of-scope boundaries explicit for subscriptions, pre-orders, inventory, and coupons? [Completeness, Spec §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is the minimal-expressiveness assumption (required/optional, bounded quantities) validated against all example kinds? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
